result.quote: For the priest had said, “She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.”
result.reason: The key correctly explains why Athaliah was killed outside the LORD’s house. However, “Why is Athaliah killed at king's house?” can instead ask why she was executed at all, for which Jehoiada’s order is also a defensible answer. The wording should use past tense, include “the,” and clarify that it asks why she was killed on the palace grounds rather than in the LORD’s house.
